pages.name: Akaishi Miner (9x9x3)
pages.text: The controller sits at the center of the middle layer. Bottom and top layers each hold one Port. U slots accept upgrade modules.

$(2,4)Build tips$(0)$(li)9x9 footprint, 3 layers tall$(li)Place the controller first, then fill the rest$(li)U slots: empty upgrade frames or installed upgrade modules$(li)One Port P at the center of bottom and top layers$(br2)Once formed, the controller links both ports and ores are pushed into their buffers.
